overview_subtitle: Key metrics and quick access to everything that matters.
dataSources_description: Every result on this page starts with an official Department of Basic Education (DBE) publication. We clean and consolidate the files, and keep the Department's figures unchanged.
dataSources_flowLabel: How the data reaches this dashboard
dataSources_resultsBody: Per-school pass rates, learner counts and subject results from the DBE National Senior Certificate reports. Subject results cover the 11 gateway subjects.
dataSources_directoryBody: School names, EMIS numbers, provinces, circuits and quintiles from the DBE EMIS masterlist, matched to the NSC report by EMIS number.
dataSources_locationsBody: School coordinates from the DBE EMIS masterlists. Province outlines come from the Municipal Demarcation Board via geoBoundaries; district outlines are derived from school locations.
dataSources_basemapBody: OpenStreetMap contributors, with licensed satellite imagery where configured.
dataSources_note: New DBE reports appear here after they are imported. If a release is missing, it has not been processed yet.
